meta.policy: signed-default codegen: use the signed spelling in generated code; ledger flags sign-ambiguous entities (cluster chosen-class is a signedness-family type AND domain size 2-8)
meta.alt_note: alt is the unsigned counterpart inferred from census domain-composition analysis (size-2 domains in int-family clusters are sign pairs); domain_size>2 means extra candidates may coexist
meta.usage: if codegen diff fails on signed-jcc / idiv / cdq patterns, flip ent to alt first
